decisions.reason: Cases without a directed production witness cannot be repaired by survivor ranking or broader runtime budgets.
A target-blind diversity policy retains a complete witness at a checkpoint where the admitted-work ledgers match, so a small non-scalar policy control is justified.
The historical endpoint matrix is diagnostic; the next central evaluation must test target-free compression and concrete known-structure capability unlocks.
The retained control does not show that exact scalar identity, value interning or history-bearing quotienting caused the observed witness loss.
The retained control does not establish an AC matcher, guard, assumption or e-graph semantic failure.
Runtime work should be selected only after profiling shows the dominant layer and an optimization increases reachable depth, coverage or proof strength.

claimBoundary: This artifact is a reversible implementation-priority decision derived from the frozen historical diagnostic corpus and its retained search evidence. It is not mathematical proof, autonomous rediscovery, external novelty, a complete causal model or a claim of general search or architecture superiority.
